ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Original schematic with susceptible, infectious and recovered categories. Infection transfers beta times S times I divided by N per day from S to I. Recovery transfers gamma times I per day from I to R. No births, deaths, migration, latent stage or return to susceptibility is modeled.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Transfers in a closed SIR population
